description: This PHP class 'SaveQualificationEducationController' handles the pre-render logic for a qualification education feature within an HRM system. It extends an abstract Vue controller and dynamically sets a Vue component based on whether an 'id' attribute is present in the request, indicating an edit or create operation.

classes.name: SaveQualificationEducationController
classes.description: Controller that manages the component selection for qualification education editing or creation. It sets the component with the appropriate Vue component name and properties based on the request attributes.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering. Checks if an 'id' attribute exists in the request and sets the component accordingly, either for editing or creating a qualification education record.
